summary: Revision answering the failed_assumption material event: independent review (verify) did not authorize the exact delivered revision at review-authorization attempt-1. Preserve the completed provision→contract→implement→gates-and-pr→verify prefix, then add a builder fix pass that consumes the review verdict and resolves the blocking findings, re-run the stack gates and refresh the PR, independently re-verify the corrected revision, re-authorize, and ship. Independent-review safety fact remains satisfied by using the reviewer role (distinct provider family from the builder) for re-verification and the ship-check.

steps.objective: Provision an isolated worktree at the ticket base revision so builder passes operate on a clean, reproducible checkout.

Produce the build contract for #2: bind the Astro/MDX/pnpm stack decision from docs/design to a concrete plan for the manifest, source layout, the first narrow product slice (one page), and the specific named behavior test plus lint command that will satisfy AC1-AC5 without placeholder gates.
steps.selectionReason: Builder owns bounded contract definition; a contract pass first constrains the greenfield stack-establishment work to one slice and enforceable gates before any code is written.

steps.objective: Implement the contracted slice: real pnpm/Astro manifest and source layout, one prototype-matched page, self-hosted fonts and design tokens as scoped by the contract, a meaningful named behavior test, configured test_command/lint_command (and setup_command) in .operon/config.yaml, and the stack rationale in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
steps.selectionReason: Builder is the sole write-access implementation role; a single implement pass delivers the full contracted slice and the meaningful gates the ticket requires.

steps.objective: Run the newly configured stack gates against the implementation and open the pull request carrying the delivered revision.

Independently verify the exact delivered revision against acceptance criteria AC1-AC5: stack rationale recorded, real manifest/layout/workflow present, non-vacuous test_command that fails when the behavior breaks, meaningful lint_command, and an observable first product result with documented run steps.
steps.selectionReason: Reviewer is a distinct provider family from the builder, satisfying the required independent_review safety fact; verify is the operation that confirms the delivered revision meets acceptance criteria.

steps.objective: Resolve the blocking findings from the independent review verdict that prevented authorization: apply the smallest sufficient corrections to the manifest, source layout, gates (.operon/config.yaml test_command/lint_command/setup_command), the named behavior test, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md rationale, or the observable first slice as required, keeping the change narrow and each review finding explicitly resolved or rebutted.
steps.selectionReason: Builder is the sole write-access role and owns the fix pass; addressing the review verdict's blocking findings is the direct response to the failed_assumption that review did not authorize the revision.

steps.objective: Re-run the configured stack gates against the corrected revision and update the pull request with the fixed delivery.

Independently re-verify the exact corrected revision against AC1-AC5 and confirm every previously blocking review finding is resolved, emitting an authorizing verdict only if the delivered revision genuinely meets the acceptance criteria.
steps.selectionReason: Reviewer (distinct provider family from the builder) re-runs verify to satisfy the independent_review safety fact against the corrected revision after the fix pass.

steps.objective: Record that an independent review verdict on the corrected revision exists and authorizes progression to the ship check.
Perform the final release-readiness check on the authorized corrected revision and emit the ship verdict for merge.
steps.selectionReason: Reviewer owns the ship-check gate pass; a final readiness verdict is required before the mechanical ship gate can merge.

steps.objective: Merge the delivered revision and emit the terminal merge verdict for the episode.
